nodes.label: Hikari connection pool keepalive fix
nodes.rationale: Without liveness checking Hikari handed out dead idle connections after the DB (or something between) dropped them, causing every request to fail with 'Connection is not available' until the backend was restarted. keepalive-time pings idle connections, max-lifetime retires them under the typical 30-min server idle timeout, and validation-timeout bounds the liveness check; idle-timeout is not set because the pool runs at fixed size.

nodes.label: Multipart upload size limit for site walkthrough videos
nodes.rationale: Raised from 50MB to 512MB to allow site walkthrough videos up to seven minutes. This is a container-level ceiling enforced by Spring before any controller runs, so it cannot be set per endpoint; the actual per-endpoint 50MB cap is enforced in code by FileService, with only the walkthrough endpoint opting into a larger limit. file-size-threshold of 1MB makes Spring stream large uploads to a temp file instead of holding them in heap memory.

nodes.label: Server-side Google Places / Maps API key config
nodes.rationale: The server-side Places API key must not be the same key the browser uses for maps: it is called only from the server, so it is locked to the server IP and to the Places API. Left blank, address autocomplete simply returns no suggestions and addresses stay manually typeable. The separate browser maps-api-key is referrer-restricted to Maps JavaScript API only, since a browser key cannot be kept secret.
